name: CopperUI
comment: Source of truth for every CopperUI constant. `make tokens` writes lib/copperui/include/copperui/tokens.h, internal/copperui/tokens.go and docs/copperui-tokens.md from this file; make check fails when one of them is stale. Units: px (device pixels, Kobo Libra 2 panel 1264 x 1680 at 300 ppi), grey (0 black .. 255 white, on the 16-level grid), ms, count, weight (400 regular, 700 bold), text, flag.
